Built in 2018 and bordering Marine Park, 2133 Haring St. Unit 2C offers a spacious open layout with abundant natural light and thoughtful upgrades throughout.

Sun-drenched rooms feature solid oak hardwood floors, 8-foot ceilings, LED recessed lighting, and window blinds throughout.

The kitchen boasts custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, ample storage, a large sink, dishwasher, garbage disposal, and a full suite of appliances.

The layout includes two bedrooms plus a versatile bonus room perfect for a home office, guest room, or nursery. The primary bedroom offers a private balcony and en-suite bathroom, while the second bathroom features a deep soaking tub.

Mechanical upgrades include Mitsubishi split A/C with multiple zones, a Navien tankless water heater, and baseboard heating for year-round comfort.

A deeded parking space with a 115V outlet allows for overnight EV charging. Conveniently located near the Q train, Avenue U shopping, and dining.
